findings.reason: Trực tiếp reads as direct/live viewing (including a broadcast); the context says this provenance is being present in the conversation when the notification arrived, not watching a live transmission. Khi nhận expresses receipt-time viewing; keep the existing precise tooltip.

findings.proposed_text: Đã đánh dấu là đã đọc
findings.reason: The adjacent đã phrases without là make the completed-action provenance label read mechanically; inserting là gives the natural Vietnamese construction for marking something as read.
